parameters.content:
## 1. Intake
Website / ad lead forms POST here.
Protected by a secret header.

## 2. Data hygiene + scoring
Trim, case, phone (E.164), country, UTMs.
Invalid leads get a 422 with reasons.

## 3. HubSpot upsert
Search by email -> update or create.
Never blanks existing data; lifecycle only moves forward.
3 retries, then ops alert + 502.

## 4. Routing
hot -> Slack alert to sales
warm -> HubSpot nurture list
cold -> saved only
